review_description: Totally professional team with above and beyond customer service. These guys know their  business and deliver the goods. So glad I chose SJ Power for my installation. Highly recommend.

Fantastic team from the start, after being contacted by Clare the office manager and asking a few questions and getting pictures to arranging site visit with Shea the owner to the install team I could not ask for anything more, they was on time, polite, and tidy.After the install they gave me a run of how the system works with instructions and APP monitoring, after install Clare followed up and completed final paperwork for grid connection with no hassle or stress, .

I decided to go with SJ Power and can say that thier service was 100% from day one to the completed installation and beyond. The intial meeting was very helpful and detailed everything I needed that will suit the already installed solar panels, then the crew that worked on the installation were outstanding, kept me up to date on their progress and took me through all details once completed. Help me out installing and understanding the app to monitor the solar and batteries performance, they also came back a couple of days later to sort out some annomalies they had found. Very helpful and I'm very pleased with the results

I first installed solar panels with them and didn’t hesitate to contact them again when I decided to add a battery and EV charger. The team was professional, efficient, and knowledgeable from start to finish.Hannah, the sales manager, took the time to explain everything clearly, adjusted the quotes to fit my budget, and genuinely listened to my needs. Claire ensured smooth communication throughout the process, making everything seamless. A big thanks to Ethan and the installation team for their excellent work and their professional, polite communication.And thank you, Shae  for leading such a great team, that’s why I like to support local businesses like yours. The customer support is also excellent: if you have any issues with your system, you’ll be promptly and reliably assisted.Highly recommend SJ Power to anyone looking for expert, trustworthy solar installation,

We had our battery installed by the team at SJ Power. Tyler, Liam, Dylan and Hunter were a great bunch of guys who were prompt, quiet and did a quality implementation. They set the battery up and gave me a run through of the process and tools used to manage our power usage. The app is intuitive and gives a simple reflection on performance. Would recommend Shae and team for anyone looking to level up their solar efficiency game!

We had solar installed on our house. I was pleased to find this owner operated team who were responsive, on time, tidy and very professional. Once the job was completed and paid for the good service kept coming with a few queries answered very promptly. I highly recommend this professional team.

We recently used SJ Power for a battery and solar installation at our house and couldn't be happier! The team were efficient, tidy and easy to communicate with. Would highly recommend using this local business for anyone wanting solar without using a sales company.Thanks
